messages.subject: MULTISPECIES MODELLING
parts:
Hi all,

If I use a dataset with 4 species, what would be the Spatio-temporal model looks like?

specieseffect = rep(1:n,4)
group = rep(1:4, each = n)
 
formula = Count ~ independent variables + interactions (if available) + f(sp, model = spde) + f(temp, model = "ar1") + f(specieseffect, model = "rw1", group = group, contro.group = list(model =  "exchangable")  

Is this correct or do I have to remove some terms or add some terms here?

Many thanks
Dan
